p: that created thee: After these threatenings he promises deliverance to his Church, because he has regenerated them, adopted them, and called them.
Fear not: When you see dangers and conspiracies on all sides, remember this benefit and the love of your God, and it will encourage you.
waters: By water and fire he means all kinds of trouble and peril.
Egypt for thy ransom: I turned Sennacherib's power against these countries, and made them suffer the affliction which you would have done, and so were as the payment of our ransom, Isa 37:9.
men for thee: I will not spare any man, rather than you should perish, for God values one of his faithful more than all the wicked in the world.
east: He prophecies of their deliverance from the captivity of Babylon, and so of the calling of the universal Church, alluding to that which is written in De 30:3.
name: Meaning that he could not be unmindful of them, unless he would neglect his own Name and glory.
together: Signifying that no power can resist him in doing this miraculous work, nor are all their idols able to do the same, as in Isa 41:22.
witnesses: To prove that the things which are spoken of them are true.
hear: Showing that the malice of the wicked hinders them in the knowledge of the truth, because they will not hear when God speaks by his word.
are my witnesses: The prophets and people to whom I have given my law.
servant whom I have chosen: Meaning especially Christ, and by him all the faithful.
brought down all their nobles: By Darius and Cyrus.
the ships: They will cry when they would escape by my water, seeing that the course of the Euphrates is turned another way by the enemy.
the sea: When he delivered Israel from Pharaoh, Ex 14:22.
waters: When the Israelites passed through Jordan, Jos 3:17.
forth the: When he delivered his people out of Egypt.
chariot and horse: Pharaoh and his mighty army.
wilderness: Meaning, that their deliverance out of Babylon would be more famous than that from Egypt was, Jer 23:7, Hag 2:10, 2Co 5:17, Re 21:5,7.

beast of the field shall honour: They will have such abundance of all things as they return home, even in the dry and barren places, that the very beasts will feel my blessings and will acknowledge them: much more men ought to be thankful for the same.
called upon me: You have not worshipped me as you ought to have done.

weary of me: Because you have not willingly received that which I commanded you, you grieved me. By which he shows that his mercies were the only reason for their deliverance, as they had deserved the contrary.
hast not brought me the small: Meaning, in true faith and obedience.
cane with money: Either for the composition of the sweet ointment Ex 30:34, or for the sweet incense Ex 30:7.
remembrance: If I forget anything that may make for your justification, put me in remembrance and speak for yourself.
first father hath sinned: Your ancestors.
teachers have transgressed against me: Your priests and your prophets.
profaned the princes of the sanctuary: That is, rejected, abhorred, and destroyed them in the wilderness and at other times.
